name: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
description:
About This Game

Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends.

A dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA. Wield acrobatic Chinese martial arts and conquer the vast battlefields of the Three Kingdoms, where mighty generals and demons stand in your way.

The Three Kingdoms period—an era during which the land is divided into three factions, with heroes fighting for their respective beliefs. Amidst the chaos, a warrior with the power of the phoenix crosses endless battlefields overrun by grotesque demons.

Wield Acrobatic Chinese Martial Arts

Embrace an evolved version of combat with well-timed deflects, which allow you to neutralize enemy attacks, and a fast-paced mix of offense and defense using a range of weapons. Combat against formidable enemies is even more acrobatic and thrilling with the use of powerful Insight Skills, enabling you to evade enemy attacks, use the terrain to unleash counterattacks, and even shift the momentum when outnumbered.

Experience the Three Kingdoms on Open Fields

Travel across the vast open fields making up famous battlefields from the Three Kingdoms period, including the Battle of Changban and the Battle of the Red Cliffs. Freely explore new environments, from fortresses carved into the mountains to enemy bases hidden away in deep valleys—a range of locations that can only be reached through three-dimensional movement. You will need to raise your Morale by challenging mighty foes, recruit enemy officers to your cause to weaken opposing forces, and employ various strategies on the battlefield to turn the tide of battle.

Survive a Dark Fantasy World Plagued by Demons

The story follows a warrior who has mastered martial arts and is devoted to aiding those in need. When their village is destroyed by Cao Cao's forces, they take up their blade and throw themself into battle with a burning need for vengeance against Cao Cao. Dive into an original dark fantasy story set amidst the turbulence of the Three Kingdoms period, where the land is overrun with demons inspired by creatures from legendary Chinese classics.

Note: Images are from an in-development version of the game and may differ from the final product.

Note: Pre-orders will be available at a later date in some countries/regions.
short_desc: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.
